title: TRIPWIRE MINE ON THE BELT
why: His feature 6 of 2026-10-12, the tripwire mine (good idea), and his answer 32: it goes on the belt like a grenade. The Tripwire Mine is a new throw. While you carry one it has a belt cell after Medical (key 9 on the usual belt), so no key you already know moves, and Q cycles to it with the grenades. Throw it like a grenade (its key or Q, then the trigger or G). Where it lands it strings a wire across the throw, out to the walls on each side or 80 each way in the open, so it spans a doorway or a corridor by itself. It arms after a moment and you can have three strung; a fourth takes the oldest down. What sets it off comes in the next build.
now: A Tripwire Mine now goes on the belt like a grenade and strings a wire across a doorway where it lands.
